nodes.label: PROJECT_HISTORY.md
Multi-tenant wedding invitation site (one app, slug per wedding)
Supabase project Wedding_invitations_db
Vercel project wedding-invitations1 (auto-deploys master)
Only @supabase/supabase-js; no animation/icon libraries
nodes.rationale: Framer Motion, Lenis and lucide were deliberately not added; CSS transitions and inline SVG cover what was needed.

nodes.label: Next.js 16.3.4 App Router, React 19.2, TypeScript, Tailwind v4
Env vars NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / ANON_KEY / ASSET_BASE
Request flow: /[slug] server component -> get_wedding RPC -> themed render
Preview mode (?preview=<token>, noindex, Preview badge)
Theme as CSS custom properties on .wedding wrapper (color-mix derived)
nodes.rationale: Couple supplies --bg --ink --primary --accent and fonts; every other colour is derived with color-mix in app/globals.css.

nodes.label: Fonts loaded from Google Fonts by config name, not next/font
nodes.rationale: Fonts change per couple, so they cannot be statically bundled through next/font.

nodes.label: weddings table (slug, config jsonb, published, preview_token, event_at, owner_email)
messages table (guestbook, approved defaults true)
memories table (guest photo uploads, approved defaults true)
guests table (RSVP data, unused by UI)
wedding_members table (owner/editor membership)
RLS on every table + SECURITY DEFINER RPCs as the access model
nodes.rationale: The client uses only the anon key; row-level security and definer RPCs control all access.

nodes.label: get_wedding RPC (SECURITY DEFINER)
post_message RPC (SECURITY DEFINER)
post_memory RPC (SECURITY DEFINER)
get_guest RPC (SECURITY DEFINER)
submit_rsvp RPC (SECURITY DEFINER)
is_wedding_member() helper function
wedding_is_published() helper function
path_wedding_published() helper function
path_wedding_member() helper function
wedding-assets storage bucket (public read, member write)
memories storage bucket (guest upload while published)
config jsonb (all page content per wedding)
nodes.rationale: One jsonb blob keeps the schema stable as templates change: a new template only adds optional keys, with no migration or RPC change.

nodes.label: Wedding row demo (design 1, Youssef & Mariam)
Wedding row demo2 (design 2, night palette)
Wedding row andrew-halla (first real client, design 2, 2026-11-03 Cairo; formerly andro-hala)
master branch (production, auto-deploy)
design2-card branch (full-screen card, vine/seal art; merged)
design2-flatten branch (remove pale panels, shared name sweep; not merged)
design3-garden branch (designs map + design 3; local only)
save-the-date-calendar branch (776367d, merged as 1d171de)
PR #1: design 2 candlelit sealed card (01fb1f8)
Claude Design mockups (Wedding Invitation.dc.html / v2)
Decision: one repo, one deployment, one row per wedding
nodes.rationale: A new client is a new row, not new code. Rejected repo-per-wedding (duplicated code/fixes, a Vercel project per couple) and branch-per-wedding (preview URLs behind Vercel login, drift from master). Branches are for review only; custom domains can later point at a slug.

nodes.label: Decision: couple stores 4 colours + 2 fonts; fixed system layer derives the rest
nodes.rationale: Keeps per-couple input small while derived roles (--bg-secondary, --text-muted, --paper, --seal, --glass-*) stay consistent; text on photos keeps its own dark overlay for WCAG AA contrast on any theme.

nodes.label: Design 1 light palette (#F7F2E8 bg, #2B211B ink, #B08D57 gold)
Canvas stamp on memory photos uses literal hex
nodes.rationale: Canvas cannot read CSS variables.

nodes.label: Decision: plain instead of next/image
nodes.rationale: Storage URLs are cross-origin; accepts 6 no-img-element lint warnings.

nodes.label: Arabic / RTL support (locale ar, mirrored doors, titleAr)
Decision: design 1 doors slide horizontally; 1300ms easeInOutCubic tap-to-open
nodes.rationale: The 3D swing was dropped in favour of a horizontal slide; reduced motion jumps instantly.

nodes.label: Gotcha: global scroll-behavior smooth hijacked per-frame scrollTo; pass behavior instant
nodes.rationale: Smooth scrolling fought the custom eased scroll, so each frame passes behavior: "instant".

nodes.label: Decision: Reveal wraps every section except the hero
nodes.rationale: The hero already animates and would flash on load.

nodes.label: wedding:open event (opening gesture starts music)
Decision: songs must be MP3 files in the bucket (<id>_song.mp3)
nodes.rationale: Spotify and YouTube links cannot feed an <audio> element.

nodes.label: Music pauses on visibilitychange / pagehide
Memories: Open camera (getUserMedia) + Choose from gallery
Memories 2-column grid, 4 per page, numbered pagination
Design 2: candlelit sealed card (config.design = 2, data-design="2")
Design 2 palette: night #1A0A0C, paper #F7E4CC, velvet #6E0D1A, gold #C8A35F
Design 2 vine and wax-seal art cut from reference screenshot (public/design2/)
nodes.rationale: Joseph's choice; vines are alpha masks tinted with the accent colour and the seal is split across the fold. Known limitation: 1x phone screenshot looks soft on desktop.

nodes.label: Decision: design 2 keeps intro/memories/music, drops closing note
nodes.rationale: Joseph's choice.

nodes.label: New optional config: events[].image and guestbook.image
Design 3 "garden / daytime botanical" template
Decision: each template is a fixed hand-written composition
nodes.rationale: A per-wedding config.sections registry was rejected.

nodes.label: Decision: refactor the design seam, then build one template to prove it
nodes.rationale: Adding a third branch to the design ternary was rejected.

nodes.label: Decision: template-specific content in optional jsonb keys (story?, travel?, faq?)
nodes.rationale: New columns or tables were rejected.

nodes.label: Decision: a template is a pure code deploy (no DB or Vercel changes)
DESIGNS map + DesignProps bundle (components/designs/1|2|3.tsx, fallback 1)
Rule: copy a shared section instead of adding props to it (components/d3/)
nodes.rationale: Template-only sections live in their own folder so shared sections do not grow per-template props.

nodes.label: Arch (design 3 opener on useOpening contract)
Story (timeline)
DaySchedule (events[] as hour-by-hour schedule)
Travel
Faq (native <details>, no JS)
Design 3 contrast fix: schedule time uses ink (gold on cream ~2.6:1)
verify3 review harness (localhost:3000/verify3, delete before merging)
Save the Date endpoint (app/api/calendar/route.ts)
Decision: Apple devices get inline .ics; everyone else redirected to Google Calendar
nodes.rationale: The old data: URI download did neither on phones; .ics opens Safari's Add to Calendar sheet and the Google link opens Android's Calendar app. Event lasts 4h; text escaped per RFC 5545 to prevent line injection.

nodes.label: assetUrl resolution (absolute/"/" unchanged, ASSET_BASE override, else Supabase)
remoteAssetUrl always uses Supabase (music, memories)
nodes.rationale: Music and guest memories have no local placeholder; the "music silent" and "memories 404" bugs came from the ASSET_BASE override.

nodes.label: NEXT_PUBLIC_ASSET_BASE (dev only; removed from Vercel production 2026-09-30)
Flat client upload naming (wedding-assets/<id>_<n>.jpeg, _cover, _background, _song.mp3)
nodes.rationale: No folders; config paths point straight at these names.

nodes.label: New client onboarding checklist
Check every uploaded file size before publishing
nodes.rationale: A 0-byte upload has happened and the dashboard skips a re-upload when the name already exists.

nodes.label: WhatsApp caches link previews; reshare with ?v=2 after changing og.image
Renaming a slug breaks the old link (/andro-hala -> 404)
Demo rows use /demo/... paths served from public/demo/
Rule: feature branches only; merge to master only on Joseph's explicit go-ahead
nodes.rationale: master auto-deploys to production, so Joseph reviews on the local dev server first.

nodes.label: Rule: one next dev per directory (Next 16)
Rule: browser-pane screenshots need a fresh fronted tab; scroll instant
nodes.rationale: Background tabs render black and pause requestAnimationFrame.
